تتبحبحين (form IIq)
# تَتَبَحْبَحِينَ (tatabaḥbaḥīna) /ta.ta.baħ.ba.ħiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of تَبَحْبَحَ (tabaḥbaḥa)
# تُتَبَحْبَحِينَ (tutabaḥbaḥīna) /tu.ta.baħ.ba.ħiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of تَبَحْبَحَ (tabaḥbaḥa)
